text: Gardening is the pleasant and rewarding practice of cultivating plants in a garden or similar location. The first essential step in gardening is to water the plants. Proper watering ensures the roots receive adequate moisture, promoting healthy growth and development. Once the soil is adequately moistened, it is time to prune the plants. Pruning is necessary to shape the plants and remove any dead or damaged branches. Properly timed pruning prevents overcrowding and maintains a healthy plant structure.
